name: Scalar Quantization
definition: A random-access decompression method implemented as per-block scalar quantization, where a minimum and maximum value per block are computed, along with a local index, to reconstruct voxel values on-the-fly.
summary: Scalar quantization is a random-access decompression method that maps voxel blocks to local min-max ranges for parallel GPU reconstruction, differing from hardware block-coding by using software-defined linear interpolation.
